info.name: ScheduCal API v1
info.description:
Complete API collection for ScheduCal calendar scheduling service.

## Authentication
Every endpoint authenticates with HTTP Basic authentication: `Authorization: Basic base64(apiKey:apiSecret)`. This collection sets Basic auth once, at the collection level, from the `apiKey` and `apiSecret` collection variables; every request inherits it. Set those two variables to your credentials before sending.

A missing, malformed or wrong `Authorization` header returns `401` with `WWW-Authenticate: Basic realm="ScheduCal"`. Valid credentials on a suspended account return `403`.

Sending `apiKey` and `apiSecret` in the JSON request body is deprecated: it is still accepted for now, but will be removed.

## New Features (December 2025)
- `gmailFirstInvite` field in Create and Invite responses indicates first-time Gmail user priming

## Response Format
All responses follow this structure:
```json
{
  "success": true|false,
  "message": "Human readable message",
  "data": { ... },
  "apiVersion": "v1"
}
```

request.description:
Create a new calendar appointment with optional initial invitee.

## Request Fields
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| appointmentSubject | string | No | Subject/title |
| appointmentBody | string | No | HTML body content |
| appointmentStart | string | Yes | ISO 8601 start time |
| appointmentEnd | string | Yes | ISO 8601 end time |
| appointmentTimeZone | string | Yes | Time zone |
| appointmentLocation | string | No | Location |
| name | string | No | Initial invitee name |
| address | string | No | Initial invitee email |

## Response
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Appointment created successfully",
  "data": {
    "appointmentId": "AAMkAGI2...",
    "subject": "Team Meeting",
    "start": "2024-01-15T10:00:00",
    "end": "2024-01-15T11:00:00",
    "timeZone": "America/Los_Angeles",
    "location": "Conference Room A",
    "inviteeCount": 1,
    "hasInitialInvitee": true,
    "gmailFirstInvite": true,
    "dateCreated": "2024-01-10T15:30:00Z"
  },
  "apiVersion": "v1"
}
```

### gmailFirstInvite Field
When `true`, indicates this is the first invitation to a Gmail-hosted email from your account. The invitee may need to check spam or approve adding to calendar.

Update an existing appointment. All invitees are notified of changes.

## Request Fields
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| appointmentSubject | string | No | Updated subject |
| appointmentBody | string | No | Updated body |
| appointmentStart | string | No | Updated start time |
| appointmentEnd | string | No | Updated end time |
| appointmentTimeZone | string | No | Updated time zone |
| appointmentLocation | string | No | Updated location |

## Response
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Appointment updated successfully",
  "data": {
    "appointmentId": "AAMkAGI2...",
    "subject": "Team Meeting (Rescheduled)",
    "dateUpdated": "2024-01-11T09:15:00Z"
  },
  "apiVersion": "v1"
}
```

Cancel an appointment. All participants are notified, and appointment.canceled is sent to subscribed webhooks.

If the cancellation can't be made in the calendar system, the call returns an error and the appointment stays active. It is safe to retry. It never returns 200 when nothing was cancelled.

## Request Fields
The body is optional; a DELETE with no body is valid.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| comment | string | No | Cancellation message |

## Response
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Appointment cancelled successfully",
  "data": {
    "appointmentId": "AAMkAGI2...",
    "subject": "Team Meeting",
    "dateCanceled": "2024-01-11T14:00:00Z",
    "isActive": false,
    "inviteeCount": 0,
    "originalInviteeCount": 3
  },
  "apiVersion": "v1"
}
```

item.name: Webhook Management
item.description: Register and manage webhook endpoints to receive real-time notifications about appointment events.

request.description:
Register a webhook endpoint to receive real-time notifications.

## Request Fields
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| webhookUrl | string | Yes | URL to receive webhooks (use HTTPS) |
| eventTypes | array | Yes | Events to subscribe to |

## Event Types
| Event | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `attendee.responded` | Attendee accepts, declines, or tentatively accepts |
| `attendee.proposed_new_time` | Coming soon: not sent yet. Attendee proposes alternate time |
| `appointment.updated` | Appointment changed with PUT /v1/appointments/{id}. Not triggered any other way |
| `appointment.canceled` | Appointment cancelled with DELETE /v1/appointments/{id}. Carries appointmentId, subject, start, end and timeZone |

Cancellation and update webhooks come only from API calls. If an appointment is removed any other way (for example, when an attendee's or the account's data is erased), no appointment.canceled is sent. Webhook start and end are wall-clock times in timeZone (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss, no Z or offset).

## Response
`201 Created`
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "webhookId": "49856464-9c29-43b0-ad45-a8a9812d82bf",
    "webhookUrl": "https://your-server.com/webhook",
    "secret": "aujHqc8fuw/dBx6quWO8d92hlHGsrsuOAXXmx2YFDc0=",
    "eventTypes": ["attendee.responded", "appointment.updated", "appointment.canceled"],
    "isActive": true,
    "dateCreated": "2026-01-01T12:00:00Z"
  }
}
```

**Important:** Save the `secret` for signature verification. It cannot be retrieved later.

List all registered webhooks for your account.

## Response
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": [
    {
      "webhookId": "49856464-9c29-43b0-ad45-a8a9812d82bf",
      "webhookUrl": "https://your-server.com/webhook",
      "eventTypes": ["attendee.responded", "appointment.updated"],
      "isActive": true,
      "consecutiveFailures": 0,
      "lastDeliveryAt": "2026-01-02T10:00:05Z",
      "lastDeliveryStatus": "success",
      "dateCreated": "2026-01-01T12:00:00Z",
      "dateUpdated": null
    }
  ]
}
```

Update webhook configuration.

## Request Fields
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| eventTypes | array | No | Updated event subscriptions |
| isActive | boolean | No | Enable/disable webhook |

## Response
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": {
    "webhookId": "49856464-9c29-43b0-ad45-a8a9812d82bf",
    "webhookUrl": "https://your-server.com/webhook",
    "eventTypes": ["attendee.responded"],
    "isActive": true,
    "dateUpdated": "2026-01-03T08:00:00Z"
  }
}
```

Delete a registered webhook.

## Response
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "message": "Webhook deleted successfully"
}
```
